The strongest setups are predominantly relapses in small-cap coins, rather than new listings. I’m anchoring probabilities to the 9.9% quiet-coin base rate and the roughly 35–37% rates for warming repeat offenders, with adjustments for current pressure and episode severity; intraday predicted dips are not treated as settled hits.

I also discounted stale-looking OI observations and announcement titles that establish only pair removals—not complete spot delisting or unavailable borrowing. MEGA and ZAMA remain outside the final list: their pre-market status creates potential arbitrage constraints, but the available announcements do not establish a launch catalyst in the target week.
